_comment: The commissioner's rulings on transactions. 'void' on an 'add' (no kind, or kind 'void'): it does not count against the weekly add budget and is not listed as an add; rosters are untouched (ROSTERS.json follows Yahoo). kind 'effective_date' on an 'add': the player is not on that manager's roster for any day before 'effective' (every reader of LINEUPS/PLAYERLOG drops those rows at load time; the logs are never rewritten) and the add counts in the fantasy week containing 'effective'. A ruling that matches no transaction raises, and so does an effective date that would drop a started game. Read by scripts/sync_transactions.py, every reader of waivers_week{N}.txt and every reader of the logs (modules/transaction_rulings.py).

rulings.reason: Benton had already claimed Paul George in the group chat during week 1; the claim had not been applied yet. Garrett's add (dropped the same day) is void and his week-2 move count was set from 3 to 2.
Added late Sunday 10-25 after every game had finished; counted as a week 2 move.
